findings.description: The inline policy grants wildcard (*) actions on ec2, s3, lambda, and cloudwatch services on all resources, violating least privilege and allowing the IAM user to perform virtually any action on these services.
A long-lived IAM access key/secret is created for a human/service user rather than using temporary credentials or roles, increasing the risk of credential leakage and misuse if exposed.

findings.issue_category: standalone IAM user with attached policy
findings.description: Creating an individual IAM user with directly attached broad permissions (rather than using roles or groups) increases attack surface and makes credential compromise more impactful.
